NORTHWOOD HIGH

1668 Kempsville Road, Virginia Beach, VA. Home of the Lions. A strictly policed 1999 environment characterized by intense accessibility barriers, the "Shadow of Columbine" security theater, and the overarching dominion of Mrs. DeMarco.

The Architecture of Isolation

Northwood High is a physical manifestation of obstacles. From the "Blue Mile" (industrial carpet creating rolling resistance) and the singular Dover hydraulic elevator acting as a failure chokepoint, to the "Kidney Breaker" chairs that force wheelchair users into isolation at the back of the classroom. The school functions as the ultimate foil to the curated safety of the Crimson Node ecosystem.

Mascot The Lion (Purple & Gold)
Era Fall 1999 – Spring 2003

Courtney Evans

The Illusion

Matt's first high school girlfriend. Enamored with the curated "School Matt," but utterly unwilling to accept the clinical reality of his survival requirements.

View Profile

Arthur Vance

The Guardian

Matt's deeply lovable, fiercely protective one-on-one paraprofessional aide who serves as the clinical anchor inside the high school bubble.

View Profile

Mrs. DeMarco

The Culinary Warden

The undisputed ruler of the Commons. She operates the "Shadow Law" justice system, trading physical labor (Trash Duty) for clean administrative records.

View Profile

Mrs. Periwinkle

The Dewey Decimal Terror

The Head Librarian who executes uncompromising psychological warfare. Her punishment—endless library categorization in absolute silence.

View Profile

Bernard Morgan

The Principal

An approachable and perceptive administrator who insists on first names and prioritizes student well-being above administrative bureaucracy.

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.

Closed Submission Policy
